title: The End of Elytra
description:
It's time to Face the Skies. In this cinematic demonstration we will get to see the true capabilities of complex redstone engineering with Minecraft's first viable anti-air cannon. This design has been a lot of work and I felt inspired to make something cinematic out of it. The song I used is called Helix by the one and only Flume.

ALL FOOTAGE IN THIS VIDEO IS ACTUAL GAMEPLAY DONE WITH REAL VANILLA MECHANICS. Mods and tools like Flashback for gameplay recording and carpet for scripting were used along with iris shaders like Re-Thinking Voxels and Bliss to enhance visuals. I would also like to thank Velizar for helping me patch the stupid networking code that made arrows fly like lightsabers.

I also made use of builds such as the CV68 Nimitz Aircraft Carrier by Kioi and Ilydris, an adventure map designed by Zetry.
